notes.title: Rooms is coming to consoles!
notes.content:
Long time no see, but we never met directly so anyways... here's a big news!

[h1][b]Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle[/b] is coming to [b]PS4[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7579421/ce6095a61c2524d63f5fc443a507cf30afe51ee1.jpg[/img]

[h1]PlaysStation 4[/h1]
[b]The PS4 version features 144 levels with PSVR support[/b].
It will hit the US and EU market on [b]June 19th![/b] (That's right next Tuesday)

[h1]Nintendo Switch[/h1]
[b]The Nintendo Switch version features a Co-Op mode with a new character and story line.[/b]
It will hit the global market around the end of [b]Summer, 2018[/b].


We'll also update the SteamVR version to include all 144 levels soon.

Thanks!

-Jake

notes.title: Patchnote 1.06 - Jump between VR & non-VR!
notes.content:
Hello there!

We made a few updates!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7579421/c9bc167771d8d18d94e8a0317637ccd2a0826994.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Save file syncing (Windows only)[/h1]
-[b]Finally, the Save files between VR and non-VR version (Windows) are synced now![/b]

-If you have any progress on the non-VR version, run the non-VR version first. It will copy the save files to the new location (C:/Users/(UserName)/AppData/LocalLow/HandMadeGame/Rooms2).
-When you run either VR or non-VR version, it will cross-check another version and sync the save data.

-[b][Warning!][/b] This means, if you RESET the game date from one version, it will also RESET ANOTHER VERSION's date, so BE CAREFUL.

[h1]2. Minor visual fixing[/h1]
-Fixed broken lightmap
-Unlocked levels are much brighter now. 

[h1]3. Audio stuttering issue fixed[/h1]
-Sometimes music was stuttering, but but this should be fixed.


As always, if if encounter any issue, please send email at
jkim@handmadegame.net

Also, please take a look at [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/517970]CRANGA!: Harbor Frenzy[/url], our new VR game :)

Thanks!

-Jake

notes.title: CRANGA!: Harbor Frenzy is coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Our new VR game, [b]CRANGA!: Harbor Frenzy[/b], is coming soon on Steam and Oculus![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7579421/cad84e08fdb6f0f49bc3ce20d7839edd8bdca6b9.jpg[/img]

[b]CRANGA!: Harbor Frenzy[/b] is a casual VR puzzle game that brings popular block-pushing games to a whole new level. In CRANGA, players control an industrial crane to push and remove shipping containers from a teetering tower. In order to ensure the container's safe removal, players must utilize physical space to move and see the container tower from various angles. With different container types, items, and game modes, this seemingly simple task will turn out to be a great challenge. Jump into the whimsical harbor where your physical and mental skills will be tested! 
One wrong move will bring about epic destruction… 

[list]
[*]Unique twist on the popular Block-Pushing game with Crane in VR
[*]Simple, Fun, and Comfortable yet Challenging Gameplay
[*]Various Container Types, Items, and Game Modes
[*]Local Multiplayer - Play with Friends! (Network Multiplayer coming soon!)
[*]Vive controller support - Use your Hands!
[/list]

[h1]December 6th, Check the Date![/h1]

Please visit the [url=www.playcranga.com]Official Game Website[/url] or the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/517970]Steam Store Page[/url] for more info.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.05 - Achievement in VR, Fixing bugs
notes.content:
Hello, 

It's been a while. I apologize you guys for being late patching these ːsteamsadː
We've been quite occupied developing our next VR game, [url=store.steampowered.com/app/517970]CRANGA[/url] 
This patch is only for the VR version.

[b]1. Achievement now works in the VR version[/b]

[b]2. Made all arrows / menus clickable in VR[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7579421/43201bca811f90e23e2c80408240293ba8c0ebb8.jpg[/img]
-You could press the Right/Left side of the touchpad to flip the page, but many people seemed like they couldn't find it and thought the game is broken. Now, it's just clickable with Vive controller.

[b]3. Removed the "trial version" text[/b]


One of the major upcoming patch is integrating the SAV file between VR and non-VR version. This needs to be done very carefully, so I need some time to implement and make sure everything works fine.

Meanwhile, if you find any issue, please send an email directly to me at jkim@handmadegame.net
(I often miss hecking the forum)

Thanks! 

-Jake, HandMade Game

notes.title: Discontinuing Oculus Key distribution soon & DK2 support on Steam
notes.content:
Hello there,

We are discounting giving out the Oculus Key for Steam purchasers soon. We will only accept the request by the end of May. 

The reason for the decision is to keep the value fair with different stores. We want various virtual reality stores to grow and make a healthy ecosystem. However, we were giving too much advantage on Steam purchasers by giving out the Oculus keys for free. We want more users to buy and play the game on the Oculus Store, too. 

As this is an unpleasant news for some, we'll have some time before stopping this support as mentioned above.

Also, please note that Oculus DK2 does not work in SteamVR. If you wish to play the game with DK2, you should buy it from the Oculus Store. 

Thanks!

-Jake, HandMade Game

notes.title: Patch Note 1.03 & Recovering save files (if deleted)
notes.content:
Hello there,

It's been a while. I added some features and fixed some bugs.

-Changed basement level access icon to make it more visible
=> Many players didn't seem to realize that there are basement levels, so I made it more clear. There are 48 (= 12 levels x 4 themes) basements levels. 

-Added Steam Controller support. 
=> You can slide the right touchpad to move a room. 

-Fixed a bug when exiting the game - sometime the game froze when exiting. 


And... a few users have reported save data being reset after the last patch. I think the different branch of the game have been mixed up. I am terrible sorry. 

In the latest version, the game stores save files in the local Steam folder below.
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Rooms2\Data\user

If you still have the issue after the latest patch, please navigate to the folder below and copy and paste PlayData.SAV & Rooms.SAV to the Steam local folder above.
C:\Users\(UserName)\AppData\LocalLow\HandMadeGame\Rooms_ The Unsolvable Puzzle\Data\user

For any further issue, please leave as comments here. 

Thanks!

Thanks!

-Jake, HandMade Game

notes.title: [Urgent] Lost save file issue & Fix
notes.content:
Hello there,

We're very sorry for the lost save file issue happened with the recent patch. This happened because dummy save files were included in the patch, and currently it seems there are no way to retrieve the original save file. 

However, you can use this cheat code to skip the level to where you were. 
Press [b]Left Alt + P[/b] in a gameplay screen to skip a level. 
Press [b]Left Alt + U[/b] to unlock all levels. (requires restarting the game) 

We apologize for the issue again. 


안녕하세요 핸드메이드 게임입니다.

최근의 패치 후에 게임을 실행하시면 세이브파일이 지워지는 버그를 겪으신 분들께 사과의 말씀을 드립니다. 패치에 임시 세이브파일을 실수로 포함하여 일어난 일로, 현재로썬 원본 파일을 복구할 방법은 없습니다.

대신, 아래의 치트키로 저장되었던 레벨까지 진행하실 수 있습니다.
[b]왼쪽 Alt + P[/b] - 게임화면 중 레벨 스킵
[b]왼쪽 Alt + U[/b] - 전체 레벨 언락. (재시작 필요)

죄송합니다 ㅠㅠ

-Jake, HandMade Game.

[왼쪽 Alt] + [P] - 게임화면 중 레벨 스킵
[왼쪽 Alt] + [U] - 전체 레벨 언락. (재시작 필요)

죄송합니다 ㅠㅠ

-Jake, HandMade Game.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.01b

The last patch caused mouse cursor to stuck in the middle even when a controller is not connected. I reverted that change back, so it will work fine now. 

Below is the patch note.


*Fixed the cursor disappearing bug.

*Fixed a bug with room rotator - this caused a situation where you cannot grab a key even you are in the same room. 

*Fixed odd smoke fx position when you use room rotator.


Thanks!

notes.title: Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Finally, Rooms is back! 

[h1]Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle launches on PC, Mac, and Linux on 6 languages right now! [/h1]

It was a long way coming back to where it should have started in the first place. For those who know the history of the game would get what that means. Despite all odds, we're very happy to bring it on Steam finally!

The game features 144 puzzles levels, 4 beautifully crafted mansion themes and music, complete storyline with two endings, full controller support, and  more upcoming.

[b]People who buy Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle will get 66% discount on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/304500/] Rooms: The Main Building [/url]until June 1st[/b], so don't miss the chance! 

Great Thanks to All.
